correctness.rationale: Exact score-count degree identity; independent half-sample empirical processes converge to one Brownian bridge; finite marked-score removal establishes asymptotic independence; the O(sqrt n) position block has O(n^{1/4}) stochastic error; continuous evaluation establishes the stated joint distribution. The limiting covariance uses exact Brownian bridge kernel integrals. A standalone standard-library checker passed 186 finite assertions, independently confirming all finite degree means and covariances through n=7; finite checks do not constitute proof of asymptotic convergence.

value.rationale: The natural critical sqrt(n) positional window is where independent macroscopic degree proportions and strongly correlated local fluctuations meet. The new structural joint law resolves a scientifically motivated dependence gap not answered by prior marginal limits or finite covariance. It specifies universal shared Gaussian empirical bridge randomness sampled at independent marks, while each coordinate has a rank-dependent drift; enables coupled degree-tail and joint fluctuation analysis.
